benchmarks.name: COCO 2014
benchmarks.reference: Lin et al., Microsoft COCO: Common Objects in Context, ECCV 2014
benchmarks.licence: Annotations CC BY 4.0. Images under the Flickr terms of use, with the licence of each image listed in the annotations.
benchmarks.terms: Images are fetched one by one from the official host and never redistributed. The host publishes no checksum of single images, so they are not pinned.

benchmarks.name: COCO 2014 training images
benchmarks.reference: Lin et al., Microsoft COCO: Common Objects in Context, ECCV 2014
benchmarks.licence: Images under the Flickr terms of use.
benchmarks.terms: No task reads these images. Steering methods fit their directions and calibrate their thresholds on them, and each image is fetched from the official host when a method names it.

benchmarks.name: POPE
benchmarks.reference: Li et al., Evaluating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models, EMNLP 2023
benchmarks.terms: Question files are downloaded from the official repository. Copies in other repositories differ and are not used.

tasks.description: Object presence questions on 500 COCO val2014 images, with absent objects drawn at random.
Object presence questions on 500 COCO val2014 images, with absent objects drawn among the most frequent ones.
Object presence questions on 500 COCO val2014 images, with absent objects that co-occur most with the present ones.

benchmarks.name: RePOPE
benchmarks.reference: Neuhaus and Hein, RePOPE: Impact of Annotation Errors on the POPE Benchmark, arXiv 2504.15707
benchmarks.terms: Corrected labels of the POPE questions, with ambiguous questions removed. Downloaded from the official repository and never redistributed.

tasks.description: The POPE random questions with corrected labels, which reuse the answers given to POPE.
The POPE popular questions with corrected labels, which reuse the answers given to POPE.
The POPE adversarial questions with corrected labels, which reuse the answers given to POPE.

benchmarks.name: CHAIR
benchmarks.reference: Rohrbach et al., Object Hallucination in Image Captioning, EMNLP 2018
benchmarks.licence: MIT (OPERA repository, whose script and image list are used)
benchmarks.terms: The metric predates vision language models and fixes no images, prompt or length. The 500 val2014 images are those of the greedy LLaVA-1.5 run published with OPERA, read from its log for their identifiers only.

tasks.description: Detailed descriptions of 500 COCO val2014 images, scored for objects that are mentioned but absent.

options.prompt: Please describe this image in detail.

benchmarks.name: MME
benchmarks.reference: Fu et al., MME: A Comprehensive Evaluation Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models, arXiv 2306.13394
benchmarks.licence: Apache 2.0 tag on the hosting repository. The images come from third parties.
benchmarks.terms: The release archive is downloaded from the address the authors link and never redistributed.

tasks.description: Two yes or no questions on each of 1187 images in 14 perception and cognition subtasks, used to measure general capability.

benchmarks.name: VTI demonstrations
benchmarks.reference: Liu et al., Reducing Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models via Latent Space Steering, ICLR 2025
benchmarks.terms: Faithful and hallucinated descriptions of COCO train2014 images, on which VTI fits its directions. Downloaded from the official repository and never redistributed. No task reads them.

benchmarks.name: REVIS pairs, calibration questions and vector
benchmarks.reference: Wu et al., REVIS: Sparse Latent Steering to Mitigate Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models, ICML 2026
benchmarks.terms: Pairs of descriptions and object presence questions on COCO train2014 images, on which REVIS computes its vectors and calibrates its gate, and the vectors its authors release for LLaVA-1.5. Downloaded from the official repository. No task reads them.

benchmarks.name: Nullu pairs
benchmarks.reference: Yang et al., Nullu: Mitigating Object Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models via HalluSpace Projection, CVPR 2025
benchmarks.terms: Truthful and hallucinated descriptions of 5000 COCO train2014 images, from LURE, on which Nullu builds its subspaces. Downloaded from the official repository and never redistributed. No task reads them.
